title: TITLE: Krish's pick
subtitle: Movin' To The Sun started as an AI demo by a Reiki master, then a DJ and a house legend finished it. The Grammys split it in two. Here is who did which bit, and why that's the question to ask at work.
youtube_description:
Movin' To The Sun reached number two in the UK. It started with a Reiki master's lyrics and an AI music app. HUGEL, a DJ and producer, rebuilt the track from small pieces of her AI version, and Ultra Naté sang the new version, with a thin layer of the AI singer kept underneath.

So is it AI music or human music? The Grammys couldn't pick one: out of the songwriting categories, still in for performance.

The better question is who did which bit, for a song or for the work on your desk.

The full deep dive is at makeyourmindup.ai

linkedin_post:
A Reiki master with no studio wrote a UK number two. An AI app made her first version, a producer rebuilt it and a house legend sang it. The Grammys couldn't file it under one word.

The work on your desk is increasingly made the same way. "Did AI make this?" tells you very little. Ask whose idea it was, what a tool drafted and who checked it before it reached you.

The full deep dive is at makeyourmindup.ai.
